title: A BED FIT FOR A GIANT
introduction: Lord Aldric, the ruler, invites you in to admire a new bed. The extra-long legs were meant to impress visitors. Now your host needs your help getting into it.

choices.label: Build a small step
choices.outcome: Lord Aldric climbs in using your step, then asks you not to mention this outside the house. You leave the step where it can be found tonight.

choices.label: Ask whether it came with a ladder
choices.outcome: Lord Aldric laughs once, then notices that you are still looking for the ladder. Your joke travels better than the invitation to visit again.

choices.label: Suggest shortening the legs
choices.outcome: Lord Aldric admits the carpenter could shorten the legs. The sensible suggestion earns a nod; your host would rather you had admired the bed first.
